questions.question: Why did King Hezekiah of Judah destroy the bronze snake that Moses had made?

answers.text: People had been burning incense to it
It had cracked beyond any repair
The king of Assyria wanted it

questions.question: The Bible says no king of Judah was like King Hezekiah, either before him or after him. True or false?
King Hezekiah of Judah defeated which people as far as Gaza?
Why did the Assyrians capture Samaria and send the Israelites into exile?

answers.text: They would not listen to the LORD or obey
Their city walls were built too low
Their army was too small to fight back
